blocks.text:
After breakfast, you will head to Christ the Redeemer on Corcovado. From the station, the train travels through the lush greenery of Tijuca's tropical forest. The forest lies right within the city, so the journey to Rio's best-known landmark also offers a brief introduction to Brazil's natural world. Children who keep a lookout may spot birds and animals along the way.

The train climbs to the 38-metre statue of Christ the Redeemer. Unveiled in 1931, the monument has long been one of the city's main symbols. From the summit of Corcovado, you can enjoy panoramic views of Rio, the ocean and the surrounding mountains.

After the tour, return to your hotel to relax.
